OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

CONNECTOR_MAX_TLP.description: The highest TLP of the entities the connector is allowed to enrich. Entities marked with a higher TLP are skipped and never sent to the external source.

ONYPHE_BASE_URL.description: The ONYPHE API base URL (with a trailing slash).

ONYPHE_CATEGORY.description: The ONYPHE data category to query: `ctiscan` or `riskscan`.

ONYPHE_TIME_SINCE.description: The time window of the ONYPHE data to retrieve (OQL `-since` value, e.g. `1w`).

ONYPHE_DEFAULT_SCORE.description: The default score of the created observables.

ONYPHE_IMPORT_SEARCH_RESULTS.description: Whether to import the search results as observables when enriching an indicator.

ONYPHE_CREATE_NOTE.description: Whether to attach the enrichment summary as a note on observables, instead of their description.

ONYPHE_IMPORT_FULL_DATA.description: Whether to import the full raw application response text (can produce large data).

ONYPHE_PIVOT_THRESHOLD.description: The maximum number of results of an observable enrichment: above it, nothing is imported.

ONYPHE_INDICATOR_MAX_RESULTS.description: The maximum number of results of an indicator enrichment: above it, the query is considered too imprecise and nothing is imported.

ONYPHE_PATTERN_TYPE.description: The vocabulary entry of the ONYPHE indicator pattern type.

ONYPHE_ENRICHMENT_TYPES.description: Comma-separated list of OpenCTI object types to create during enrichment, empty for all types. Valid values: Domain-Name, Hostname, IPv4-Address, IPv6-Address, Autonomous-System, X509-Certificate, Text, Vulnerability.

ONYPHE_TEXT_FINGERPRINTS.description: Comma-separated list of fingerprint pivot labels to create as Text observables, empty for the default sha256-preferred set (e.g. hhhash-sha256, favicon-sha256, ssh-fingerprint-sha256).
